Community Ras Al Khaimah

Designed Around Everyday Life

Landscaped walkways, water features, and shaded courtyards run through the heart of the community — a masterplan built for slow mornings and evening walks as much as it is for the villas themselves.

The Central Courtyard

Water Gardens at the Heart of the Community

A ribbon of pools and channels winds between the villa rows, anchored by the community mosque — the everyday backdrop for residents on their way in and out.

The Masterplan, From Above

420 Villas, Framed by the Water

Rows of G+2 townhouses run perpendicular to the waterfront, with the community’s parks, pools, and mosque held at the centre — every villa a short walk from green space.

The Masterplan

Community Features

AFM Township’s community zone — 50% of the total masterplan — is designed to give every resident daily life within walking distance of home.

Central Community Clubhouse

A shared social heart for the township, steps from every villa row.

Multiple Landscaped Parks

Green space woven throughout, with every home a short walk from one.

Swimming Pools

Community pools set within the shared landscaped grounds.

Children’s Play Areas

Dedicated, safe spaces for the youngest residents to play close to home.

Jogging & Cycling Tracks

Dedicated paths that loop through the community’s green corridors.

Dedicated Retail Plaza

Everyday shopping and dining within easy reach of every villa.

Mosque

A place of worship placed at the heart of the masterplan.

Community School Zone

Planned to keep education close to where families actually live.

Multi-Purpose Sports Courts

Shared courts for basketball, padel, and everyday games.

24/7 Security & Gated Access

Round-the-clock security across a fully gated community.

Community Gym

A dedicated fitness facility within the community, separate from each villa’s own space.

Coffee Shop, Salon & ATM

Everyday conveniences built into the plaza, alongside the supermarket.

The Market Opportunity

Why Ras Al Khaimah?

Ras Al Khaimah has evolved into one of the UAE’s most promising real estate markets, supported by strong economic growth, increasing investor confidence, and long-term development plans.

A Market on the Rise

Apartment prices up ~32% year-on-year and villa prices up ~11%, reflecting growing demand and sustained market activity.

A Major Tourism Destination

A landmark integrated resort on Al Marjan Island opens in 2027, expected to attract millions of international visitors.

Demand Backed by Fundamentals

Transaction volumes at multi-year highs; the emirate welcomed a record 1.36 million visitors last year.

A Diversifying Economy

RAKEZ has welcomed 19,000+ new companies, supporting job creation, population growth, and housing demand.

Compelling Value for Investors

A more accessible entry point than Dubai, backed by significant infrastructure investment and long-term growth potential.

A Secure Investment Environment

Foreign freehold ownership, escrow-regulated off-plan developments, and a transparent legal framework.

The Opportunity

The Case for Investing Now

01

Values are on a clear upward trend — apartment prices have risen approximately 32% year-on-year, with villa prices up around 11%.

02

A defined growth catalyst arrives in 2027 — a major new integrated resort on Al Marjan Island is set to significantly increase international visitor numbers.

03

Demand is grounded in real activity — transaction volumes are at multi-year highs, alongside a record 1.36 million visitors last year.

04

The economy is diversifying quickly — RAKEZ has added more than 19,000 new companies, expanding the base of residents and long-term buyers.

05

Meaningful value relative to Dubai — a materially lower entry point, positioning early buyers ahead of anticipated demand as the market matures.

06

Buyer protections are already established — freehold ownership zones, escrow-regulated off-plan purchases, and a transparent legal framework.
